title: File locker
description: Encrypted temporary storage, cleaned up after handoff.
storageNeeded: Connect your cloud storage before depositing files.
serviceNeeded: Limited pickups and web sharing require the new pickup service. Basic storage supports personal use with unlimited pickups.
legacyService: The pickup service is incompatible. Upgrade it to use limited pickups and stop sharing without deleting files.
noItemsHint: Choose a file, set the pickup rules, then start the deposit.
loadFailed: Could not refresh the list. Previously loaded items are retained.
stale: Status is unconfirmed. Refresh the connection before continuing.
encryptedStorage: Files are encrypted in your cloud storage
historyRetention: Ended records are kept for 7 days
clearHistoryConfirm: Only records whose cloud cleanup has completed will be cleared. Active deposits are not deleted.
selectFirst: Choose a file, then confirm the rules for this handoff.
dropHint: Drop a file here or choose one
fileLimit: One file per deposit · Up to 100 MiB
name: Display name
invalidHours: Enter a whole number of hours from 1 to 878400.
invalidPulls: Enter a whole number of pickups from 1 to 1000000.
foreverWarning: Never expiring with unlimited pickups is long-term storage. Consider using the file vault instead.
shareHint: Create a link and pickup code after depositing
policyHint: The expiry timer starts when the deposit completes. Expiry or exhausted allowance blocks new pickups and starts cleanup.
selectDoesNotUpload: Choosing a file does not upload it.
onlyOne: Only one file can be deposited at a time.
tooBig: The file exceeds the 100 MiB limit.
uploading: Encrypting, uploading and registering the file…
backgroundHint: The task continues if you return to the list. This phase cannot be cancelled.
resultUnknown: The result is unconfirmed. Check this operation instead of submitting again.
operationMissing: The operation record is not available yet. Check again later; it will not be resubmitted automatically.
depositPartial: The file is deposited, but sharing is not ready. You do not need to upload it again.
shareWarning: The recipient needs the full link and code. Forwarding the complete handoff details grants access.
selfSuccess: This deposit is for personal use. Retrieve it in the same workspace using the pickup code.
lookupHint: Look up the file, then confirm where to save it.
ownCodeHint: The code looks up a deposit in your current workspace.
ownSelected: The file is selected from your deposits. No pickup code is needed again.
sharedCodeHint: Paste the complete link, including the decryption information after #.
invalidLink: Enter an HTTPS share link including the complete decryption information after #.
lookupFree: Looking up, viewing details and copying information do not consume pickups.
waitLookupHint: Verify the pickup details to check expiry, allowance and save location here.
vaultTargetHint: Keep as a long-term encrypted file
consumeHint: Receiving uses one pickup allowance. Recovery reuses the original operation.
savedAwaitingAck: The file is saved, but service acknowledgement is pending. Resuming will not download it again.
legacyHint: This file uses the old protocol. New limited-pickup and safe share-revocation rules require migration.
migrationConfirm: Migrate “{{name}}” using the current remaining allowance and original expiry. No pickups or time are added. Update all receiving devices first.
migrationLocalWarning: A legacy personal file's remaining count comes from this workspace. Historical pickups on other old devices cannot be reconciled. Only new pickups are coordinated by the service after migration.
inFlight: Pickup in progress · No free allowance
stopShareHint: Stop new shared access while keeping the file for yourself. Transfers already started may continue; downloaded copies cannot be recalled.
deleteHint: Deletion stops new pickups, invalidates links and starts cloud cleanup. Recovery of unfinished pickups will also stop.
cleanupHint: New pickups are blocked. The file is only marked cleaned after remote deletion is confirmed.
vaultEmpty: There are no files available to deposit from the vault.
readOnly: This workspace is read-only. Deposits, pickups and sharing changes are unavailable.
serviceConfiguredHint: The service address and credentials are configured. Return to connection settings to verify the version, credentials and storage binding.
shareStopped: Sharing stopped. The deposited file is retained.
deleteRequested: Deletion requested. Check the cleanup result.
connectionHint: Cloud storage holds ciphertext. The pickup service coordinates allowance and web sharing.
safeRetry: This result can be resumed using the original operation without starting another pickup.
notRecoverable: This operation cannot currently resume. Review the error or check its status again.
